scope: Current D1 FHS/peak-POT descriptions, native recursion, normalization/tail construction, retained six NA classifications, 24 output-cell metadata, displayed D1 tables and resource/complete-cell claims. No optimizer, financial forecast rerun or test suite was invoked.
method_description_agreements: The W completed label origins run from r-H-W+1 through r-H; increment fitting uses their same position envelope with W+H-1 unique increments.
Training-only increment RMS normalization, constant-mean Gaussian QMLE GARCH(1,1), frozen coefficient/residual-pool blocks and causal observed-state variance updates match code and frozen protocol.

The manuscript's local GARCH coefficient subscripts distinguish those parameters from regression and preference notation; displayed native mean/innovation/variance recursion matches the implementation.

FHS uses2048 iid standardized-residual draws with replacement, bound to source/H/W/refit seed inputs and frozen within refit blocks; native signed position path maxima include h=0 and use corrected headroom rank ceil(19(M+1)/20).

Peak POT divides mature peak headroom by the in-sample historical one-step sigma from the refit filter. It freezes one fitted GPD tail per refit and rescales its quantile with issue-time one-step sigma, then adds the current absolute-position floor.

The manuscript correctly distinguishes peak-headroom POT from McNeil-Frey's filtered one-step return-innovation tail procedure and multi-period sums. It explicitly retains anchor/volatility, drift, variance-path and overlapping-label approximation limits.

The six NA descriptions do not mislabel successful-optimizer persistence exclusions as optimizer nonconvergence or predictive inferiority; no incomplete-cell score replaces a missing complete-cell comparison.
Separate48-slot multiplicity and post-result working-reference caveats do not imply control across every supplement or independent unseen-dealer validation.
